topic: Whether the static prototype should enter usability testing

claims.proposition: The prototype is ready for static usability testing.
claims.changeCondition: A critical authority misconception appears in dry-run review.

steelmanCertificates.restatement: A static test can probe comprehension without claiming live control.
steelmanCertificates.strongestObjection: A polished mock may create false confidence.
steelmanCertificates.changeCondition: Label every control as non-live and test teach-back.

critiques.statement: Testing must exclude runtime efficacy claims.
critiques.changeCondition: The protocol explicitly limits the study to comprehension.

terminal.statement: Run a static comprehension study that makes no runtime claim.
